## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/validate-skills.mjs` passes
- [ ] `npx skills add . --list` shows the skill
- [ ] `node --test` passes
- [ ] Tried it with a real agent (which one, on which OS?)
- [ ] Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux (Node.js scripts, no shell-specific commands without an alternative)
- [ ] `skills/<name>/README.md` documents the skill
- [ ] Root README **Skills** table links to the skill and other sections are up to date
